cards: The gods bound Loki over three sharp stones
with the guts of his own son.
Skaði hung a venomous serpent over his face.
His wife Sigyn catches the drops in a bowl.
When she empties it, Loki writhes: that is an earthquake.
Nordic Reign · from the album Before the End Begins
